row.team_price_text: Enterprise: up to $250 per contributing developer per year
row.evidence: Renovate's hosted-app docs say developers log in using the OAuth credentials from their cloud-based Git repository; no SCIM, SAML or user-management API is documented for Community or Enterprise.
row.notes: Slug 'renovate' is Mend Renovate (Mend.io). Renovate CLI and Mend Renovate Community are free; Mend Renovate Enterprise (cloud or self-hosted) is priced at up to $250 per contributing developer per year. Renovate keeps no user directory of its own: sign-in and access follow the Git platform (GitHub, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps), so there is nothing to provision. Status 'none' is by absence after searching the pricing page, docs search index, hosted-app docs and self-hosted API docs. The broader Mend AppSec platform is a separate product and was not scored here.

plans.name: Mend Renovate Community (Cloud or Self-hosted)

plans.name: Mend Renovate Enterprise (Cloud or Self-hosted)
plans.price_text: Up to $250 per contributing developer per year
plans.notes: 'Up to' price, so the per-user field stays null. SSO/SCIM false by absence.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint documented. Renovate has no separate user directory: users sign in with their Git platform account and see what their platform access allows. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

user_api.notes: The self-hosted APIs cover sync, jobs, system and reporting; no user-management API is documented. False by absence.

fallbacks.other_sync: Access is derived from the Git hosting platform (GitHub, Bitbucket, Azure DevOps OAuth sign-in; web UI access follows platform permissions).
